# The Build Log

> George Fifth's public record of hackathon events, projects, demos, and source links. The site presents this work as a pixel-art RPG.

The site is a personal build journal. It does not offer accounts, subscriptions, or a paid product.
Project descriptions and event results reflect the linked public records. Follow each project's source link for current details.

## Main page

- [The Build Log](https://georgefifth.xyz/): Browse hackathon events, build notes, project demos, and source links.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://georgefifth.xyz/sitemap.xml): Current public page list.
